_note: A synthetic before-and-after practice-session form, as one question-sequence record: fifteen questions of the three shipped types (text, choice, rating). The focus rating is a rating with its own bounds laid over the type's.

questions.label: What are your goals for this session?
questions.placeholder: e.g. a cleaner first bar, stay calm

questions.label: Which skill is your main focus today?
What specific actions will you take to work on that?
What is your focus plan when things go wrong?
questions.placeholder: e.g. breathe, reset, one step at a time

questions.label: How will you know this session was a success?
questions.placeholder: e.g. three clean runs in a row

questions.label: Why / why not?
questions.placeholder: What helped or got in the way?

questions.label: What were you happiest about today?
What upset or frustrated you today?
What will you improve next time?
What is your one priority for next time?
Today's lesson (one line you want to remember)
